body:
Fixed in 758672a64. `itemIndex` is now declared outside the multiline-list loop, and after `projects.set(currentProject, symlinks)` the parser sets `index = itemIndex - 1` so the outer loop resumes at the first unprocessed config line. Inline `symlinks: []` behavior is unchanged. I also added coverage for a multiline symlink list followed by an inline empty symlink list.

Validation:
- `npm test -- --runInBand tests/ao/orchestrator-secret-symlink-contract.test.js`
- `npm test -- --runInBand tests/ao scripts/workflow/__tests__`
- `npm run workflow:codex-preflight -- --json`
- `git diff --check`
